text:
maria: Customer on acct acct_998 reported invoice tokens ~12% higher than dashboard for 2026-02-28 to 2026-03-01. They use SSE chunking and see many partial gens. Example request id: req_9a8b. Can we triage?

alex: Can you paste the raw SSE payloads and any request_ids? Also which dashboard metric you're comparing?

maria: Dashboard metric: 'tokens_consumed_total' in billing console. Invoice spike at 03:12 UTC. Sample SSE transcript:
```
event: chunk
data: {"id":"req_9a8b","delta":"Hello\n"}

event: chunk
data: {"id":"req_9a8b","delta":" world\n"}

event: done
data: {"usage":{"prompt_tokens":48,"completion_tokens":0}}
```
Note customer cancelled their client after first chunk and then reconnected to finish. They see dashboard show 48 tokens but invoice counts ~96.

tara: @maria thanks — could be double-commit when gateway retries after client cancel. Looks like INF-462 where a retry path commits partial usage then the subsequent completion commit wasn't deduped. Can you repro with curl?

maria: Repro steps:
1) curl -N "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?req=req_9a8b" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
2) wait for first 'chunk' then Ctrl-C to cancel
3) immediately re-open same request id -> server resumes and sends remaining chunks
(Observed: metrics show two usage commits for same logical generation when reconnects happen within ~20s.)

emma: I pulled metering logs for acct_998; request_ids: req_9a8b, req_4f7c, req_c12d. sse_retries metric spikes at 03:12 (see console link: https://console.redwood.ai/billing/acct_998/metrics) :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

ben: There was a gateway deploy at 03:05 UTC that introduced a client-retry handling path. I'm planning to revert the retry dedupe change; suspected cause is duplicate usage commits when stream_session_id isn't propagated to downstream metering. Assigning to eng-runtime to hotfix.

sam: Rolling hotfix now (revert + idempotency guard). Also adding server-side idempotency keyed by stream_session_id + seq_number so reconnects won't double-commit. ETA ~30m.

lucy: Finance here — once you have affected request ids and credited token totals, we'll process credits. Please send a CSV with columns account,request_id,credited_tokens.

maria: Will DM the CSV to @lucy and notify the customer. Thanks all. :handshake:

eng-oncall: Action items: (1) hotfix deploy (sam) (2) backfill credits (sam + lucy) (3) add alert for sse_retries spikes (ben). I'll follow up in #incidents if we need a postmortem. Closing thread unless new info. :white_check_mark:
